name: @arraypress/image-pipeline
description: Images in the browser, done properly: what Chrome can encode and how big, a linear-light Lanczos resampler that works in bands, crop, turn and flip geometry, a quality search for a target file size, EXIF read and rewritten (orientation, location, thumbnail), EXIF put back into JPEG, PNG and WebP, colour profiles detected, palette PNGs and animated WebP written. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --test tests/*.test.js && npm run duplication
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && diff -r -x '*.js' .types src && rm -rf .types

author: David Sherlock
